claim(address,address).details: Permissionless — anyone may trigger a claim on behalf of a fee owner.      Reverts with `NoFeesToClaim` if there is nothing to claim.

params.feeOwner: The account to send the balance to.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

storeFees(address,address,uint256).details: Requires `msg.sender` to be an allowlisted depositor. Uses balance deltas so      fee-on-transfer tokens credit the actual received amount.

params.feeOwner: The account to credit the received fees to.

returns._0: True if the interface is supported.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

addDepositor(address).notice: Adds an allowlisted depositor that can call `storeFees`.

allowedDepositors(address).notice: Allowlist of addresses that may call `storeFees`.

availableFees(address,address).notice: Returns how much of `token` is claimable by `feeOwner`.

claim(address,address).notice: Transfers the entire escrowed `token` balance to `feeOwner`.

feesToClaim(address,address).notice: Balance of claimable fees for each (feeOwner, token) pair.

storeFees(address,address,uint256).notice: Pulls `amount` of `token` from `msg.sender` and credits it to `feeOwner`.
